product: Mice and keyboards on the Bragi property protocol
works: battery level (property 0f), shown when the device answers a read of it
firmware version (13) in the device info
mice: DPI (21 / 22) and polling rate (01), shown as readings only, each when the mouse answers a read of it
mice: sleep timer 1-60 minutes (0e) and sleep timer on/off (0d), written and read back, each offered only when the mouse answers a read of it
keyboards: brightness 0-100% (02, 0-1000), written and read back, offered only when the keyboard answers a read of it; polling rate (01) shown as a reading
the model behind a generic Slipstream receiver (1BA6, 1BDC, 2B00, 2B1B) from its product id (property 12 on endpoint 09)
steps back while iCUE runs (no connect, no write)
all from docs/brands/corsair.md and simulated devices only (tests/sim-corsair-bragi-peripherals.mjs); never run on a real mouse or keyboard
doesNotWork: firmware updates and receiver pairing (never: they stay in iCUE)
changing DPI, DPI stages (1e / 1f) and the polling rate: not in the native helper's SET list (docs/handoff/drivers-round3b.md)
angle snapping (07), lift height (06), left-hand mode (52), button response (b0): write-only in every source
lights, per-key colours, key and macro assignments (handle writes; OpenRGB drives Corsair lights)
keyboards with 128- or 1024-byte packets (K70 RGB Pro / Optic, K70 RGB TKL, K65 RGB Mini / Pro Mini, K100 RGB) and the 1BE3 Scimitar RGB Elite: the helper's channel opens 64-byte collections only
older NXP-protocol mice and keyboards (K70 MK.2, K65 RGB, M65 Pro / Elite, Dark Core RGB SE, Scimitar Pro, Sabre RGB)
unconfirmed: whether these devices take the headset frame (report id 02) the helper sends; if not, the driver gets no reply and offers nothing
the HS80 RGB Wireless (0a69, 0a6b, 0a71) and other headsets: device-library/corsair-bragi-headset and DeviceHub's own headset page
